newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's gov't says maintains CVRD sale schedule.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's gov't says maintains CVRD sale schedule.

text.p: The Planning Ministry reiterated its plans for privatizing Brazilian state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) in the first quarter of 1997, a ministry spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman noted, however, that there might be a slight delay in the selloff process because of the high number of investors seeking information on the company in the so-called Data Room.
She said the auction could be delayed until early April because many investors showed interest in visiting the Data Room in the last two weeks.
Vale's privatization is expected to begin in March.

Folha de Sao Paulo daily today said Vale's selloff would start only in the second half of the year because of discussions over the re-election amendment. It also said the change in the schedule would give the government more time to evaluate Vale's copper and gold finds in northern Brazil.
Brazil's National Privatization Council (CND) is expected to meet January 29 to discuss the bid specifications for Vale's selloff, newspapers said.
The ministry spokeswoman said, however, the council's agenda has not been defined yet.
